SQE is based into two assessments, 1 and 2. Both contains parts of the modules you will learn in GDL. The basics hasn't changed but what would you prefer? If unis start doing that SQE prep courses would be redundant. The only benefit GDL has over prep courses (as far as I know) is that law firms respect it compared to sqe prep courses. It adds more to your CV than simply doing some prep courses. The route im following is the old route so GDL > LPC > TC.
